name: pericentriolar material 1

function.text: PCM1 encodes pericentriolar material 1 protein. Annotated molecular activities include molecular adaptor activity and protein-macromolecule adaptor activity. It participates in centrosome cycle and cilium assembly.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with tyrosine kinase fusion. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
